Package com.codeup.novabook.exception

Class AuthenticationException

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Throwable
java.lang.Exception
java.lang.RuntimeException
com.codeup.novabook.exception.NovaBookException
com.codeup.novabook.exception.BusinessException
com.codeup.novabook.exception.AuthenticationException
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class AuthenticationException extends BusinessException
Exception thrown when authentication or authorization failures occur.

This exception is used throughout the NovaBook system to indicate authentication failures, such as incorrect email/password combinations or expired sessions. It extends BusinessException as authentication failures are user-correctable conditions.
